guesses.reason: Short dense coat with classic brown-gray mackerel striping, an 'M' on the forehead, and an average moggy build point to a random-bred shorthair tabby.
The bold dark tabby markings on a silvery-brown ground resemble American Shorthair patterning, though the kitten's lean frame and large ears are less typical.
The large, upright, slightly pointed ears and warm tawny tones around the muzzle and legs hint at a possible ticked-breed influence.

breed.appearance: A young, slender kitten with a short brown mackerel tabby coat: dark charcoal stripes over a grayish-brown base, warm tan-ochre tints on the cheeks, muzzle, inner legs and paws, and a cream-white chin. She has very large, upright ears with pinkish insides and fine ear furnishings, round amber-green eyes rimmed in dark lines, a brick-pink nose outlined in brown, and a crisp tabby 'M' on her forehead with dark stripes running back over the head. She wears a thin purple collar and has striped forelegs with tan, tufted paws.
breed.fun_fact: No two tabbies share exactly the same stripes, so Ginger Rogers' coat is a one-of-a-kind masterpiece!
